question: Should this bot replacement be refreshed and merged with focused runner/Codex proof, or should maintainers require live Codex/WhatsApp wedge proof first?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the fix is narrow, but the PR carries human-review status and the remaining risk is proof sufficiency plus session/message overlap during late Codex cleanup.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Rebase or adapt the branch to current main, rerun checks, and allow automerge if the focused lane-release regression still passes.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live or Crabbox Codex app-server wedge demonstrates that late cleanup does not corrupt session state or delivery.

options.title: Pause Or Close Replacement
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and close or pause this replacement if the stale branch is no longer worth integrating after current Codex refactors.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Rebase or adapt the branch to current main, rerun checks, and allow automerge if the focused lane-release regression still passes.
